answer: Proof of Stake serves as a nebula for decentralized identity, requiring agents to bond assets as nectar to validate transitions. By passing reputation through a prism of weighted governance, the system ensures that influence scales with capital commitment rather than ephemeral account generation. An attacker faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring a majority share of the total staked value, rendering a Sybil attack economically irrational compared to the yield earned through honest network participation.
